```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse) # for {dplyr} functions
library(rio) # for importing data
library(here) # for easy file referencing
library(sf) # for shapefiles
library(lubridate) # to work with dates
```

# Simulated Data
```{r}
sim_pop <- here::here("sim_pops", "blockRe0p60_clusterRe0p50_gamma2p00_sim1.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

```{r}
sim_cases <- sim_pop %>% 
  filter(infected == 1)
```


## Cleaning
### all cases
```{r}
infected <- sim_cases %>% 
  mutate(symptom_onset = tau - round(runif(1, 3, 10), 0)) %>% 
  select(ID, Cluster, cluster_block, TIRS, symptom_onset)
```
write to txt file
```{r}
write.table(infected, file = "infected.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)
```
1248 infected people only

ok wow i cannot do this many people it would take way too long
i'll try with....100? 200?
```{r}
sample <- sample(infected$ID, 100)
hundred_pos <- infected %>% 
  filter(ID %in% sample)
```
write to txt file
```{r}
write.table(hundred_pos, file = "hundred.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)
```


### reported cases only:
```{r}
sim_reported <- sim_pop %>% 
  filter(reported == 1)
```

# Real Data
import data:
```{r}
## cases
suspected <- here::here("data", "TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()
```

## Cleaning
```{r}
# Cases only (no negative diagnoses)
cases <- suspected %>% 
  filter(Diagnosis != "Negativo") %>% 
  filter(Comentario != "Negativo")

# missing data?
sum(is.na(cases$MZTIRS))
which(is.na(cases$MZTIRS))
cases[63,]

cases <- cases %>% 
  mutate(block_id = ifelse(is.na(MZTIRS), str_sub(ID, 3, 4), MZTIRS))
```

Format to match c.positives.alpha.txt
```{r}
positives <- cases %>% 
  # IDperson, IDblock, IDcluster, date_symptoms, TIRS_arm, coordinates
  select(ID, block_id, CLUSTER, Week_onset, Arm_1TIRS, lon, lat) %>% 
  rename(person_id = ID,
         cluster_id = CLUSTER,
         week_sympt_onset = Week_onset,
         trial_arm = Arm_1TIRS)

```
